example: An evidence record has determination true and a current definition input. After the definition changes, validation reports stale evidence without modifying the record. {cite}`requirements.definitions.inputs`
rationale:
The example is tested by `cyclic_dependencies_are_required_once_and_changes_require_review` in tests/definitions.rs (lines 117–184). It carries a `{test}` reference to `requirements.definitions.reassessment`.

- **Setup:**
  - `fixture()` and `capture()` write a record for `rules.ready`. Its inputs are a requirements input and two definition inputs, `glossary.a` and `glossary.b`. Each definition input has `definition` and `text` set to the raw fenced declaration.
  - `approve()` sets `determination` to true.
  - `validate_repository` then returns no errors, so the record is current.
- **Definition changes:** The test rewrites `md/glossary.md` in two ways. One changes the phrase option. The other changes the body text. Each time, `validate_repository` reports an error containing "input text changed" and naming `glossary.`. That is the expected stale-evidence report.
- **Record not modified:** After each change the test asserts `before == fs::read(&path)`. The record bytes are unchanged, as the example requires.
- **Related behavior:** A pure move of the definition (leading blank lines added) produces no errors. Re-running `capture` and `approve` after the changes validates cleanly. Removing or duplicating a definition input yields the "found 0" and "found 2" errors. These checks go beyond the example but are consistent with it.

The example cites `requirements.definitions.inputs`, which is context only. The test also verifies the diff and snapshot behavior that requirement describes.

text: An evidence record has determination true and a current definition input. After the definition changes, validation reports stale evidence without modifying the record. {cite}`requirements.definitions.inputs`

Evidence inputs MAY have a definition form containing exactly `definition` and `text`. `definition` MUST identify one named definition; `text` MUST contain its complete raw fenced declaration as source lines, including its phrase option and explanatory body.

Validation MUST reject missing definitions and changed snapshot text, identifying the definition and showing a compact diff when available. Moving an unchanged definition within its chapter MUST NOT invalidate its snapshot. Evidence displays MUST show the definition name, current source location, and recorded text.
